'''pinkfloydfan death star plans''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[pinkfloydfan]]
* '''Published:''' 24 February 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Scenario
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Dagobah: Yoda's Hut|Dagobah-L-dagobahyodashut.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Dagobah: Yoda's Hut
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 Dagobah Yoda's Hut pinkfloydfan LS.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck is built only for a pre-special edition format game as secret plans will annihilate it.

The published list has 51 cards.

== Strategy ==

the startegy is very simple. use the surprise assaults only when the have a few guys at a site (2 minimum, but the more the better).the lift tube is used to help complete 2 turn dsp's. luke's back helps get luke faster, deploy luke at yoda's hut, revolute it and drain for more. levitation cancels shut him up or shut him down(cancels dsp). i have a bad feeling about this – relocate presence of the force to yoda's hut, move expand the empire( used to piss off the opponent(who probably wouldn't expect to see this card to be played). stone piles help deplete opponents hand but you can alter them and then retrieve them just to get a larger differential in the win. uncontrollable fury - play on vader so they lose an additional 2 force each turn as he cannot battle luke.

i am currently undefeated with this deck in pre special edition format and my largest win was by 52 cards and smallest win was by 43 cards.

please rate and leave comments/suggestions.
